body.message:
Well noted regarding your arrival timing.

However, we would like to inform you that, as a holiday home, our operating hours are from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and the standard check-in assistance is available between 3:00 PM and 6:00 PM.

Kindly arrange your arrival within this time frame, as this building does not allow self check-in. One of our representatives will need to be present to assist you with the check-in process.

Thank you for your kind understanding and cooperation. We look forward to welcoming you.
